review_requirements: Confirm that the 2017-06-07 protocol and independent analysis document are the governing pair for NCT01944423/R34DA034658 despite the 2014 running footer in the amended protocol.
Verify the source-printed saliva-cotinine unit and decide whether it should be corrected from mg/ml to ng/ml in an adjudicated gold requirement.
Define the primary efficacy and safety populations and treatment-attribution rules.
Adjudicate estimands and intercurrent-event handling for PPA, lapse and relapse.
Operationalize the logistic GLMM time function, random effects, cohort level, visit contrasts and small-sample inference.
Define Cox time origins, censoring, ties and proportional-hazards diagnostics.
Specify the primary missing-data rules separately from the pattern-mixture sensitivity analysis.
Resolve hierarchy, multiplicity, alpha and interval conventions across smoking, psychological and mediation analyses.
Verify every critical locator against the rendered one-based physical PDF pages.
